summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, disclosing remuneration arrangements for Interim CFO Ron Edmonds following the departure of former CFO Robert Long. Edmonds receives a USD 450,000 base salary (pro-rated for ~75% FTE), a maximum 100% short-term incentive, and director share rights worth USD 95,000. The interim term is 3-6 months. The board authorized the announcement; no advisors named. This is a routine management succession disclosure, not a forced or abrupt departure triggering a special situation. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16.
